howItWorks.title: Communication in Three Simple Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From selecting symbols to speaking out loud, Loquor AAC makes it effortless.

steps.title: Choose
steps.description: Tap pictogram symbols from a customizable grid, or type freely with smart word predictions.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Smart grammar automatically conjugates verbs, selects articles, and forms grammatically correct sentences.

steps.title: Speak
steps.description: Press speak to hear your message in a natural voice - choose from device voices or premium AI options.

features.title: Everything You Need to Communicate
features.subtitle: Built with clinicians, caregivers, and AAC users to reduce friction and cognitive load.

cards.title: Symbol and Text Communication
cards.description: Tap pictogram symbols or type freely. Build messages naturally with a configurable 6-12 column grid, a message builder strip, and smart word prediction.

cards.title: Smart Grammar Engine
cards.description: Automatic verb conjugation, perfect tense, continuous aspect, and reflexives - all handled silently. Supports Dutch, English, French, and Spanish with language-specific rules.

cards.title: Premium AI Voices
cards.description: Free offline device voices or premium ElevenLabs AI voices for natural, expressive speech. Automatic fallback ensures communication never stops.

cards.title: Progressive Vocabulary
cards.description: A 6-level learning system that grows with the user. Words unlock progressively based on real usage, with ghost slot previews and a floating readiness indicator.

cards.title: Three Grid Modes
cards.description: Standard Symbol Grid, Activity Boards for routines, and Core-Fringe with pinned core vocabulary. In-grid editing for full customisation.

cards.title: 4 Languages, All Offline
cards.description: English, Dutch, French, and Spanish - each with its own grammar rules, vocabulary packs, and voice options. Everything works completely offline.

cards.title: Clinical-Grade Privacy
cards.description: All data stays on-device. No tracking, no cloud uploads. PIN-protected admin access keeps settings safe from accidental changes.

cards.title: Multi-User Profiles
cards.description: Completely isolated profiles for each communicator with separate databases and settings. Easy profile switching, duplication, and a guided setup wizard.

grammarSpotlight.title: Smart Grammar That Thinks Ahead
grammarSpotlight.subtitle: Tap a subject and a verb, and Loquor handles the rest. Context-aware conjugation across four languages.
